items.title: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities. Continuum for code vulnerabilities discovers, validates, prioritizes, and remediates code vulnerabilities at machine speed.

items.title: AWS CloudFormation now simplifies stack update rollback operations
items.blurb: AWS CloudFormation now makes it simpler to complete an update rollback and get back to deploying. An update rollback returns your stack to a known good state.

items.title: AWS Direct Connect announces 100G expansion in Bangalore, India
items.blurb: Today, AWS announced the expansion of 100 Gbps dedicated connections at the existing AWS Direct Connect location in the Netmagic DC2 data center near Bangalore, India.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports customizing the Customer Profiles app on the agent workspace
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer Profiles now allows administrators to customize which customer data that agents see in the agent workspace, and how it is displayed, using layouts they build in Profile Explorer.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports a 5-second default refresh interval
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless reduces the default refresh interval to 5 seconds for both search and vector collections. The refresh interval controls how quickly newly ingested documents become available for search.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI announces training session APIs for serverless model customization
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization now supports training session APIs, giving customers full control over their post-training algorithm without provisioning or managing GPU infrastructure.

items.title: Cloudflare Brings On-Demand CPU and Memory Profiling to Production Workers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has introduced on-demand CPU and memory profiling for Workers and Durable Objects, allowing developers to investigate performance bottlenecks in production using interactive flamegraphs. By Craig Risi
